input.free_text_description: This system is a authentication platform that serves User, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for app exceptions handler, user entity, user repository. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a User, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a User, I want to use app exceptions handler capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
